messages:
olivia-support: FYI invoice INV-98765 is on hold for VAT/reverse-charge. Customer uploaded a 2-page resale cert for Helix Therapeutics GmbH (DE123456789) but our VIES check returns INACTIVE. PO 12345 is on the invoice and finance won't release without confirmed reverse-charge approval. :eyes:

invoicebot: Invoice INV-98765 status -> on_hold (reason: TAX_VAT_REVIEW)

anna-billing: Can you attach the exact PDF filename and confirm whether the VAT ID on the cert matches the billing contact? We often see branch suffixes (DE123456789-01) or extra whitespace.

olivia-support: Filename: Helix_ResaleCert_2026-03-10.pdf (2 pages). Customer says page 2 is a translation/letter. They claim merchant is registered and will use reverse charge. PO 12345 must be on final invoice per their AP team.

sven-engineer: Can you run our VIES proxy to capture the raw response? e.g. ```bash
curl -s 'https://internal-vies/api/check?vat=DE123456789' -H 'X-Request-ID: INV-98765'``` Paste response. If VIES says INACTIVE we still can accept manual proof but need tax approval.

olivia-support: Paste of proxy response below: ```{
  "vat": "DE123456789",
  "status": "INACTIVE",
  "message": "VAT number not currently active in VIES registry"
}```

anna-billing: Okay. Two paths: 1) ask customer for an official government extract (registration) + signed resale declaration in English OR 2) escalate to tax for a manual reverse-charge acceptance with documented risk. Which does finance prefer?

james-ops: Quick note: our invoice webhook sometimes truncates multi-page PDFs when file size >4MB. Confirm file size and that page 2 didn't get dropped during upload. If it was truncated the certificate we saw may be missing the signed declaration.

olivia-support: File size is 1.2MB, both pages uploaded. Customer attached both pages in the portal.

taxbot: @anna-billing @olivia-support Tagging EU-tax-team. Policy: if VIES returns INACTIVE we require at least two independent proofs: (a) official national tax registration extract showing VAT ID active, OR (b) notarized resale certificate + company registration doc. Translation acceptable. Also need AP contact and PO confirmation.

anna-billing: I'll request the national registration extract and ask them to confirm PO 12345 is correct. I'll also flag that the VAT has a potential branch suffix — ask them to provide VAT without suffix.

olivia-support: Message sent to customer at 09:12: "Thanks — can you upload a national VAT extract or notarized resale cert (English translation ok)? Also confirm the VAT number with no branch suffix and reconfirm PO 12345 for the invoice release."

customer (Helix AP) via email pasted by olivia-support: "Attached: Helix_ResaleCert_2026-03-10.pdf (signed). National extract attached as Helix_VAT_Extract_DE123456789.pdf. VAT shown as DE123456789. We confirm PO 12345 is valid. Please release under reverse charge"

anna-billing: Received the extract, looks legit. Forwarding to EU tax for quick review.

taxbot: EU-tax-team review: national extract confirms VAT active as of 2026-03-08. Manual reverse-charge can be approved. Required notes: (1) store both docs in evidence, (2) add customer AP contact to invoice metadata, (3) record rationale for manual acceptance.

anna-billing: Approved. I'll add the evidence to the invoice record and mark reason_code=manual_vat_override. Then finance will release.

invoicebot: Invoice INV-98765 status -> released_to_billing (agent: anna-billing)

olivia-support: Customer notified, card on file attempted and initially declined earlier but customer provided updated card details via portal — charge succeeded. :tada: 

james-ops: Follow-up action: we'll add a mapping rule to strip common branch suffix patterns (e.g., -01, /BR) when running VIES lookups and surface the raw proxy response to agents in the UI. Filing a small ticket to eng-infra: INF-3829.

olivia-support: Closing loop with customer now. Notes added: "Manual reverse-charge approved after national extract validated. Evidence stored. PO 12345 confirmed. Invoice released and charged." :white_check_mark: 

anna-billing: FYI: keep the uploaded files for 10 years per compliance. I've set retention flag on the evidence object.

sven-engineer: For transparency, adding the curl command and sample response to our internal KB (support.playbooks/vat/manual-override) so agents can follow the same repro steps.

olivia-support: Thanks all. Marking thread resolved.
